info.title: The Jira Cloud platform REST API

200.description: Returned if the request is successful.

401.description: Returned if the authentication credentials are incorrect or missing.

defaultGroups.description: The groups that are granted default access for this application role. As a group's name can change, use of `defaultGroupsDetails` is recommended to identify a groups.

defaultGroupsDetails.description: The groups that are granted default access for this application role.

groupDetails.description: The groups associated with the application role.

groups.description: The groups associated with the application role. As a group's name can change, use of `groupDetails` is recommended to identify a groups.

key.description: The key of the application role.

name.description: The display name of the application role.

numberOfSeats.description: The maximum count of users on your license.

platform.description: Indicates if the application role belongs to Jira platform (`jira-core`).

remainingSeats.description: The count of users remaining on your license.

selectedByDefault.description: Determines whether this application role should be selected by default on user creation.

userCount.description: The number of users counting against your license.

userCountDescription.description: The [type of users](https://confluence.atlassian.com/x/lRW3Ng) being counted against your license.

16x16.description: The URL of the item's 16x16 pixel avatar.

24x24.description: The URL of the item's 24x24 pixel avatar.

32x32.description: The URL of the item's 32x32 pixel avatar.

48x48.description: The URL of the item's 48x48 pixel avatar.

groupId.description: The ID of the group, which uniquely identifies the group across all Atlassian products. For example, *952d12c3-5b5b-4d04-bb32-44d383afc4b2*.

self.description: The URL for these group details.

User.description:
A user with details as permitted by the user's Atlassian Account privacy settings. However, be aware of these exceptions:

 *  User record deleted from Atlassian: This occurs as the result of a right to be forgotten request. In this case, `displayName` provides an indication and other parameters have default values or are blank (for example, email is blank).
 *  User record corrupted: This occurs as a results of events such as a server import and can only happen to deleted users. In this case, `accountId` returns *unknown* and all other parameters have fallback values.
 *  User record unavailable: This usually occurs due to an internal service outage. In this case, all parameters have fallback values.

accountId.description: The account ID of the user, which uniquely identifies the user across all Atlassian products. For example, *5b10ac8d82e05b22cc7d4ef5*. Required in requests.

accountType.description:
The user account type. Can take the following values:

 *  `atlassian` regular Atlassian user account
 *  `app` system account used for Connect applications and OAuth to represent external systems
 *  `customer` Jira Service Desk account representing an external service desk

appType.description:
The app type of the user account when accountType is 'app'. Can take the following values:

 *  `service` Service Account
 *  `agent` Rovo Agent Account
 *  `unknown` Unknown app type

applicationRoles.description: The application roles the user is assigned to.

displayName.description: The display name of the user. Depending on the user’s privacy setting, this may return an alternative value.

emailAddress.description: The email address of the user. Depending on the user’s privacy setting, this may be returned as null.

expand.description: Expand options that include additional user details in the response.

groups.description: The groups that the user belongs to.

guest.description: Whether the user is a guest.

key.description: This property is no longer available and will be removed from the documentation soon. See the [deprecation notice](https://developer.atlassian.com/cloud/jira/platform/deprecation-notice-user-privacy-api-migration-guide/) for details.

locale.description: The locale of the user. Depending on the user’s privacy setting, this may be returned as null.

name.description: This property is no longer available and will be removed from the documentation soon. See the [deprecation notice](https://developer.atlassian.com/cloud/jira/platform/deprecation-notice-user-privacy-api-migration-guide/) for details.

timeZone.description: The time zone specified in the user's profile. If the user's time zone is not visible to the current user (due to user's profile setting), or if a time zone has not been set, the instance's default time zone will be returned.
